title: Repeal/replacement with non-positional provision lineage
adversarial_claim: Article numbers and document succession are insufficient to reconstruct provision ancestry; the official correlation table must control asserted structural lineage.

document_relationships.expectation: Regulation 1184/2006 codifies and replaces Regulation No 26.

provision_alignments.expectation: The official correlation table establishes old Article 4 → new Article 3 structural lineage.

non_atoms.expectation: Same numeric Article 3 must not be asserted as lineage: old Article 3 is deleted while new Article 3 descends from old Article 4.

ambiguities.description: The correlation table establishes structural correspondence, not proposition-level semantic continuity.

requirements: Machine-compare normalized lineage fixture emissions against PRESENT and ABSENT expectations.
